calls.title: Discovery call w/ GrowthBook and Gregory Event Services
calls.summary: The team discussed their event marketing strategy, emphasizing the need for competitor research before committing to sponsorships or participation in events. Ashley Stirrup raised concerns about the lack of competitor presence at Google Next, prompting Lisa Gregory to suggest analyzing competitor participation in key events to optimize spend and lead generation. The strategy-first approach aligns with client KPIs and DevRel goals, aiming to integrate event campaigns with broader marketing efforts. A phased approach was proposed to build a flexible event strategy, supported by a geographically diverse team in the US and Europe. The company boasts 2,800 users, including 150 enterprise clients, highlighting the potential for targeted marketing strategies. Immediate next steps include initiating research sessions and refining event strategies based on feedback and insights.
calls.keywords: Event Marketing, Sponsorship Strategy, Data Science Communities, Competitor Research, Tech Conferences, DevRel Engagement
